title: AgentTask
description: What a lead agent hands a subagent when delegating. Every field is required deliberately - vague delegation (a bare objective string) is the documented cause of subagents duplicating each other's work. See reference/multi-agent-architecture-notes.md section 3.

role.description: Agent role id, must match a definition in specs/agents/.

objective.description: Specific, concrete goal - not a generic topic string.

outputFormat.description: Expected shape of the distilled return value, e.g. 'bullet list of findings with source URLs'.

allowedTools.description: Explicit tool allowlist for this task, a subset of the role's scoped tools in specs/agents/.

boundaries.description: What distinguishes this task from sibling subagents' tasks - the explicit division of labor.
